characters.name: Jason Duval
characters.tagline: A former soldier with ties to the Keys’ smuggling trade.

sections.heading: His corner of Leonida
sections.body: Jason’s established base is in the Leonida Keys. He stays at a property owned by Brian Heder in exchange for helping with local criminal work, tying his home life to the same smuggling circle that includes his friend Cal.

sections.heading: Before Lucia
sections.body: Crime was part of Jason’s upbringing. A spell in the Army offered a route out of his troubled teenage years, but he eventually returned to drug-running work. He wants a more comfortable future; Lucia becomes both his romantic partner and his partner in crime.

sections.heading: What the footage shows
sections.body: Promotional scenes place him alongside Lucia in robberies and armed escapes, while quieter screenshots show fishing and pool with Cal. His everyday friendships matter alongside the action.

facts: Drug running and local criminal jobs

trivia.text: His Marauder tattoo and military-themed clothing echo the Army background described in his biography.

characters.portraitReason: Warm, recognizable face; stronger profile lead than a distant action frame.

characters.name: Lucia Caminos
characters.tagline: Out of prison, with a plan for a different future.

sections.heading: Where her story begins
sections.body: Lucia’s story connects Liberty City, Leonida Penitentiary and her new life with Jason. Her family’s hopes for a better life remain important as she begins again after prison.

sections.heading: Family, prison and a fresh start
sections.body: Her father taught her to fight early. Defending her family ultimately led to prison, and her release gives her another chance at the life her mother wanted. She approaches that future with a plan, determined to make more calculated decisions.

sections.heading: A partner in the action
sections.body: The promotional Extended Look places Lucia behind the wheel during Raul’s escape and alongside Jason in dangerous jobs. Her driving and fighting sit alongside the trust that holds their partnership together.

relationships.name: Her parents
relationships.relation: Her father taught her to fight; her mother’s hopes motivate her

relationships.name: Raul Bautista
relationships.relation: A shown getaway sequence connects their stories

trivia.text: Lucia is the series’ first fully voiced female protagonist, following the playable women offered in earlier GTA games.

characters.portraitReason: Clear, composed night portrait with neon color; replaces less flattering workout lead.

characters.name: Cal Hampton
characters.tagline: Jason’s friend, with a radio scanner and plenty of theories.

sections.heading: His circle in the Keys
sections.body: Cal is connected to Jason and Brian Heder’s operation. Official screenshots show him around the boat yard, fishing with Jason and playing pool at The Rusty Anchor.

sections.heading: Comfort in the familiar
sections.body: Home, beer and listening in on Coast Guard communications suit Cal just fine. He has a conspiratorial outlook and is far more content with his circumstances than Jason, whose ambitions threaten to pull him beyond their familiar routine.

sections.heading: Why he stands out
sections.body: Rockstar presents Cal as a contrast to Jason: he is content with familiar surroundings while his friend has bigger plans. Their shared connection to Brian keeps both men rooted in the same Keys circle.

trivia.text: Even birds flying in formation draw Cal’s suspicion. His official introduction turns that everyday sight into another piece of his conspiratorial worldview.

characters.portraitReason: Recognizable, relaxed full face with a bright outdoor setting.

characters.name: Boobie Ike
characters.tagline: Vice City business, nightlife and music under one roof.

sections.heading: Where his world connects
sections.body: Boobie is tied to Vice City’s Jack of Hearts club and Only Raw Records. The club places him in the city’s nightlife, while the studio connects his established business interests to an ambitious new generation of performers.

sections.heading: From the street to the boardroom
sections.body: He has built interests in property, a strip club and a recording studio after a criminal street career. His sociable manner gives way to a much firmer approach when business is at stake.

sections.heading: The next hit
sections.body: His partnership with Dre’Quan is a major priority. Only Raw Records needs a breakthrough, connecting Boobie’s established money and venues with a younger music entrepreneur’s ambitions.

relationships.name: Real Dimez
relationships.relation: Artists within the Only Raw Records network

trivia.text: Boobie describes the club’s earnings as funding the studio, with drug money underpinning the wider operation. His music ambitions remain entangled with his criminal past.

characters.portraitReason: Clear portrait with Jack of Hearts signage and Dre’Quan in the setting.

characters.name: Dre’Quan Priest
characters.tagline: Taking Only Raw Records beyond the club circuit.

sections.heading: His Vice City network
sections.body: Dre’Quan’s world runs through Only Raw Records and Boobie’s club. Official images place him both in the recording studio and among the performers and crowds of Vice City’s nightlife.

sections.heading: Music was always the goal
sections.body: Street dealing helped him get by, but his ambition was a career in music. Booking performers at Boobie’s venue was one step; signing Real Dimez gives him a chance to build something larger in Vice City.

sections.heading: The label’s moving parts
sections.body: Boobie supplies an established business connection while Bae-Luxe and Roxy bring the act he has signed. Keeping those relationships together makes the label more than a background logo.

trivia.text: Dre’Quan treats dancers’ reactions as a way to judge a record’s potential: if a song catches on in the club, he expects DJs to pick it up.

characters.portraitReason: Clean face-led nightclub portrait with atmospheric magenta light.

characters.name: Real Dimez
characters.tagline: Bae-Luxe and Roxy are chasing their next breakthrough.

sections.heading: Meet both members
sections.body: Real Dimez is the partnership of Bae-Luxe and Roxy. Their story connects them to Only Raw Records and Vice City’s music scene, with official images showing the pair at the microphone and in the studio.

sections.heading: Friends before the fame
sections.body: The pair have known each other since high school. Their early life included shaking down local dealers before they turned street experience into provocative rap and persistent social promotion. A collaboration with local rapper DWNPLY became an early hit.

sections.heading: A second shot
sections.body: Five years and considerable trouble separate that early success from their new record deal. Dre’Quan has signed them to Only Raw Records, where the duo is trying to turn recognition into another breakthrough.

trivia.text: The official gallery gives both members individual studio moments as well as a shared microphone portrait, letting their partnership and personalities come through.

characters.portraitReason: Both performers are prominent together at a microphone; prevents representing a duo with only one member.

characters.name: Raul Bautista
characters.tagline: An experienced robber whose confidence keeps raising the stakes.

sections.heading: His route into the story
sections.body: Raul recruits people willing to take on major robberies. The promotional Extended Look shows Lucia involved in his getaway, bringing his bank-robbing world directly into the protagonists’ story.

sections.heading: Experience with an edge
sections.body: He combines a seasoned bank robber’s experience with charm and careful persuasion. He is always looking for capable partners who will accept risk in pursuit of a larger reward.

sections.heading: When a score escalates
sections.body: Raul’s growing recklessness raises the pressure on his crew with each score. His partners are drawn toward bigger rewards while facing the question of how much risk they are willing to follow him into.

trivia.text: Promotional images place Raul in both polished social settings and armed criminal situations, matching the contrast between his charm and his work.

characters.portraitReason: Warm Vice City skyline, full visible face and strong character silhouette.

characters.name: Brian Heder
characters.tagline: An old hand in Keys smuggling who lets others carry the risk.

sections.heading: The boat-yard connection
sections.body: Brian operates in the Leonida Keys through his boat yard, Brian’s Boat Works & Marina. Jason and Cal belong to his circle, and Lori works alongside him in the business.

sections.heading: Business without the heavy lifting
sections.body: Brian’s experience reaches back to an earlier era of Keys smuggling. He still moves drugs but delegates much of the dirty work. His relaxed appearance masks a much harder business instinct.

sections.heading: A place to stay has a price
sections.body: Jason lives in one of Brian’s properties without paying rent, in return for helping with shakedowns and staying in touch. Brian’s third wife, Lori, works beside him at the boat yard.

trivia.text: Jason’s arrangement includes occasional visits for Lori’s sangria. The rent-free home comes with both criminal obligations and an informal place in Brian’s social circle.

characters.portraitReason: Expressive, close face with business paperwork; clearer than a distant marina frame.
